items.title: Valero (VLO) Stock Looks Reasonable On Cash Flow But Rich On Earnings
items.summary: After a very strong five year run that has seen Valero Energy deliver a cumulative return of 449.3%, the stock now sits at a point where recent momentum and mixed valuation signals are rubbing against each other. At the latest close of US$312.90, the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate points to a price that is roughly in line with the market, while earnings based multiples screen the stock as looking expensive. items.title: Valero Energy Corp's Dividend Analysis
items.summary: Valero Energy Corp (NYSE:VLO) recently announced a total dividend of $1.2 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-07-31.  This payment includes a $1.2 per share cash dividend, payable on 2026-08-31.  As investors look forward to this upcoming payment, the spotlight also shines on the company's dividend history, yield, and growth rates.
